title: Introducing Parallel Agents in Zed
snapshot_note: Structured fact packet distilled from Zed's public Parallel Agents launch post dated 2026-04-22.

facts.statement: Zed says users can orchestrate multiple agents running in parallel in the same window.
The launch post says the Threads Sidebar lets users control which folders and repositories agents can access and monitor threads as they run.
The launch post says users can mix and match agents on a per-thread basis.
The launch post says one thread can read and write across repositories while another works on a different project.
The launch post says users can isolate worktrees per thread when they want to separate edits.
The launch post describes Parallel Agents running at Zed's 120 fps.
The launch post says users can open the Threads Sidebar with option-cmd-j on macOS and ctrl-option-j on Linux and Windows.
